entries.title: Less waiting in the window with a long task history
entries.body: With a long history of finished tasks, the app reread all of it every couple of seconds and whenever a task changed, just to learn whether any work was running. It now checks only what it needs, so the window spends less time busy and answers your typing and clicks a little sooner.
entries.noPicture: This shortens time the window spends busy, which no single picture can show.
